name: Contemporary Christian Music
overview: Scripture emphasizes that true worship must be directed to God with sincerity and truth, as God is Spirit and seeks worshipers who worship in spirit and truth (John 4:24). Praise is to be offered joyfully and reverently, as seen in the call to praise God in His sanctuary and with musical instruments (Psalms 150:1; Amos 6:5). Believers are encouraged to express their worship through psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, making melody in their hearts to the Lord (Ephesians 5:19), while ensuring their hearts align with God's will rather than conforming to worldly standards (Romans 12:2; Luke 16:15).
